idx = 0
tokens = []

    # Skip whitespace
    while idx < len(_mem['s8']) and _mem['s8'][idx].isspace():
        idx += 1
    if idx >= len(_mem['s8']):
        break
    obj, end = decoder.raw_decode(_mem['s8'], idx)
    tokens.append(obj)
    idx = end
